AMD 001: The proposal submission date is extended from 12:00 PM EDT 27 April 2026 to 2:00 PM EDT 01 May 2026 due to receipt of questions received from industry that are pending answers. An additional amendment will be posted incorporating the questions and answers.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

This solicitation is for the competitive procurement of the MQ-25 Weapon Skid Adapter, P/N: 2483105, NSN: 1710-00-943-7946 in support of the MQ-25 Unmanned Air Systems (UAS) Program for the United States Navy. It is anticipated that this solicitation will result in a Firm Fixed-Price, Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) type contract. See the attached solicitation and solicitation attachments for further requirements and instructions.
